name: timezone_converter
description: Convert date/time between different timezones. Supports IANA timezone identifiers.
schema: [{"key": "date", "type": "string", "description": "Date to convert (ISO format or YYYY-MM-DD)", "optional": true}, {"key": "time", "type": "string", "description": "Time to convert (HH:MM:SS format)", "optional": true}, {"key": "fromTimezone", "type": "string", "description": "Source timezone (IANA format, e.g. Europe/Rome)"}, {"key": "toTimezone", "type": "string", "description": "Target timezone (IANA format, e.g. America/New_York)"}]
